name: Poison Tip
description:
Preparation time: 10 minutes.

Once per day: You prepare and apply a poison to a number of projectiles equal to your ranks in Craft. Roll Craft to set the Difficulty.

For the next day, whenever you hit a creature with a poisoned projectile, the creature rolls Fortitude against the Difficulty. On a failure, the creature takes -1 Defense.

Describe how you apply the poison.
successes:
✨: Each time a creature takes -1 Defense from a poisoned projectile, it also takes 1d4 damage.

🌞: Each time a creature takes -1 Defense from a poisoned projectile, it also rolls Injury.
